en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with many low houses, church or mosque towers and minarets, set in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, a large group of uniformed soldiers is resting or assembling on a grassy slope. At the top there is a decorative banner with Greek text indicating the location in Macedonia. A small number "166" appears at the bottom left, and a website watermark is overprinted near the bottom.
